articles.headline: Switzerland win pre-tournament friendly to build momentum
articles.description: Switzerland secured a comfortable victory in their final warm-up match before WC2026.

articles.headline: Switzerland captain backs young squad to go far at World Cup 2026
articles.description: The Switzerland skipper expressed confidence in the blend of experience and youth in the squad.

articles.headline: Switzerland look in fine form ahead of World Cup 2026 opener
articles.description: Switzerland trained with confidence and all key players are fit for the tournament.
